slice: RPP-5ke selected one-tail removal from a consumed MLINESTYLE
scope: Extends the selected AC1027 open, uncut, unfilled MLINE projector to remove exactly one tail element from a source-bound MLINESTYLE already used by ordinary MLINE consumers. It updates group-73 counts, truncates the per-vertex parameter arrays and recalculates retained group-41 values under the resulting style offsets. This is selected output/geometry evidence, not native CAD semantic qualification or whole-document support.

references.use: Group 73 is the number of MLINESTYLE elements; group 74 gives the repeated parameter count per element at each segment; group 41 carries those parameters; group 75/42 carry area-fill parameter counts and values. The first group-41 value is the distance along the miter vector to the element path intersection.
Group 49 carries each MLINESTYLE element offset; the selected projection is limited to style flag 2.

contract.admission: The original MLINESTYLE body, style dictionary/provider graph and every ordinary MLINE consumer must be source-bound. Exactly one final style element is removed from a modern AC1027 style with at least two source elements. All style-level fields and every retained element field must match the source exactly; the removed element must be the original tail. The selected route requires equal start/end angles, style flag 2, and one or more retained elements. Every consumer must remain live, in its original scope and model-identical during preflight. Other removal patterns, count changes, style edits composed with removal, earlier versions and unqualified carriers refuse.
contract.geometry: Each selected MLINE must be open, have at least two vertices, positive finite scale, justification 1 or 2, unit extrusion, source-consistent WCS positions/directions/miters, exactly two group-41 parameters per source element with a zero second value, and no group-42 fill values. Every source element parameter is validated before projection, including the removed tail. Retained first group-41 values are recomputed using the resulting style's offsets and justification shift; each per-vertex segment/fill array is shortened and the projected element count is reduced by one. No caller-owned MLINE model is mutated.
contract.identityAndOutput: The MLINE retains its redundant group-2 name and group-340 reference. Output proof checks style group 71 count 1, the retained group-49 offset/ACI/linetype, MLINE group 73 count 1, three group-74 counts, six group-41 values, three zero group-75 counts and absence of group 42. Fresh import verifies one style element, one parameter tuple per vertex, and unchanged WCS geometry, directions, miters, scale and extrusion for model-space and named-block consumers.
contract.failureAndRetry: A non-selected style flag refuses before publication and preserves the destination sentinel and caller state; correcting it allows a successful same-adapter retry. Non-tail removal and one-to-zero count controls refuse while preserving destination and caller state. A late live-consumer parameter mutation after entity emission refuses before publication; restoring the caller model allows a successful same-adapter retry. Successful output is reopened for semantic field readback.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. ASCII/binary read and write routes remain supported. Source and output drawings are generated at runtime and removed after success; no DWG/DXF fixture was committed.
contract.limits: Evidence covers AC1027 ASCII and binary sources crossed with ASCII and binary output, one two-to-one tail removal, exact retained style prefix, flag 2, equal angles, open/unfilled/uncut MLINEs, one model-space and one named-block consumer, three vertices, center and bottom justification, and two extrusion planes. It does not qualify non-tail removal, multi-element removal/append, one-to-zero, composed retained-element edits, other versions/carriers/schemas, native CAD rendering, document closure or independent 3D semantics. No support claim is promoted.

controls.styleAndConsumerProfile: Generated source has two style elements at offsets 1.25/-0.75, with ACI/linetype pairs (1, ByLayer) and (3, Continuous), and two three-vertex ordinary MLINEs. The tail element is removed, leaving the exact first tuple at offset 1.25. For the bottom-justified consumer the removed -0.75 offset had supplied the previous minimum; the output parameters are checked against the new -1.25 shift, while center-justified values retain their expected center offset.
controls.outputProof: For both emitted consumers, verify group 2 remains OLD_ENTITY_NAME and group 340 resolves to the emitted MLINESTYLE; verify the one-element style tuple, group 73=1, all group 74/41/75 values, no group 42, and fresh-import WCS positions/directions/miters, extents, scale, justification and parameter-array arity.
controls.failureAndRetry: Four source/output profiles and eight successful readbacks; two invalid-flag refusals are corrected and retried on the same adapter; two non-tail removals and two zero-element removals are refused; two late-consumer mutation refusals preserve sentinels and are followed by same-adapter retries.

selectedRegression.summary: 4 source/output profiles; 8 successful readbacks; 6 bounded preflight refusals; 2 late-mutation refusals; 4 same-adapter retries

affectedMlineCohort.summary: 7/7: MLINESTYLE transactions, geometry guard, source/live guard, consumed-style offset projection, offset-only 340 retarget, consumed-style append and consumed-style tail removal

next: Select one exact still-refused P2 witness, preferably a bounded multi-element append/removal or a non-tail removal only after its source and consumer-output contract are bound. Keep other count edits, retarget profiles, carriers, schemas and semantic/platform claims open.
